scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a fixed irreducible column-stochastic migration operator applied after positive diagonal habitat growth, identically in every season.
Universal spectral reversal invariance concerns asymptotic period multipliers, not equality of transients or of any particular calendar for nonreversible migration.
Historical priority is provisional; no independent validation or empirically calibrated prediction is claimed.
title: Calendar reversal detects exactly reversible dispersal in periodic patch populations
